title: Account: user first login v1
description: OWNED BY account. Serves Payment (the 14-day free trial starts from occurred_at; queue payment.user_first_login.v1). An account with the role user (never an admin) signed in for the first time: by password (POST /api/user/v2/sessions) or by Google (its first GET /api/user/v2/me). Sent once, after the database commit, persistent, application/json, AMQP type = message_type; a repeat is harmless, so consumers record message_id or user_id once. correlation_id is the request's x-request-id, or a new UUID. No name and no email. Like account.user_status_changed.v1, a user event is about no project, so the body has no project_id while envelope.v1 requires it (open point in the README). Sent on exchange account.events with routing key account.user_first_login.v1.
